1.text: Speak naturally and have your words typed directly into any app in real time.
Your workspace tracks your dictation history, live typing speed in words per minute, and daily streaks.

2.text: Step two combines your personal dictionary and AI styles.
Add custom names and jargon that work whether voice polishing is on or off.
Turn polishing on to tailor tones and voice commands.

3.text: Step three puts you in full control of your AI engines.
Run completely offline with Nemotron for speech recognition and S1-mini by Superwhisper for local grammar polishing, or plug in cloud keys anytime.

4.text: Hold your Middle Mouse Click or press Control plus Windows to speak into any application.
Voice Flow types and polishes in real time with zero copy-pasting.

4_mac.text: Finally, dictate anywhere across your Mac.
Press Command plus Option to speak into any application.
Voice Flow types and polishes in real time with zero copy-pasting.
